Brief rev 8 restates H2: design can act on the margin z (SE ratio, matched contrasts) or through misfit at fixed z (Δ). Δ(log Q) is kept only as a low-power gauge, since the positive control shows it does not respond to the departures tried. Δ ≈ 0 is worded as a statement about the margin, not about BT fit.
